conventions.origin: bottom center of the footprint, on the floor at Z=0
conventions.paths: Repository-relative POSIX paths with no leading slash.
conventions.ids: Item ids (F001) match the spreadsheet and catalog. category_id and style_id are lowercase slugs. room_id matches rooms[].id.
conventions.measured_bbox_m: Copied from metadata.json bounding_box_m and rounded to 4 decimal places (0.1 mm). min/max are axis-aligned around the floor-center origin.
conventions.photos: images.thumbnail and images.card are the model preview.png. images.lifestyle is the Unsplash photo. shared_with lists other item ids that use that same photo. photo is the same lifestyle image, kept for older readers.
conventions.colors: color.hex and materials[].hex are display sRGB. When build.py passes a color through srgb_to_linear or linear_rgb, the authored number is already sRGB. When it writes the Principled Base Color socket directly, the socket value is linear and the hex is the sRGB transfer of that value.
